clips.title: The story
paras: In the Cleft of Shadow, an initiate seeks Blind Cazul’s help with a succubus ritual. The sightless warlock points toward an object charged with mortal emotion.

A succubus answers to mortal longing, sorrow, and desire. To draw one across the veil, an aspiring summoner needs more than willpower; the demon is known to devour souls. Blind Cazul understands what the initiate seeks and knows where to find a fitting lure.

Though blind, Blind Cazul senses the lives and sorrows within Orgrimmar’s red ramparts. He sends the initiate to Zankaja, an orc woman who lives atop the bluffs near the wind rider roost. She anxiously awaits her mate Dogran’s return, and her despair can draw a demon’s attention.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hmm... But, of course, that is not why you have come to speak with me.
If Gan'rul has sent you to me, it must be that you are to summon a succubus, and need an object to use for enticement.
Hmm... If you trust a blind man to lead you, friend, then listen. In the bluffs of Orgrimmar, west of the wind rider tower, lives Zankaja. She waits for the return of her mate.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Have you come with news of Dogran? He was to have returned days ago, and I have heard nothing...
